# Kinetis Vector

> A schema-driven admin platform for Kinetis applications. Resources
> declared over kinetis/orm entities compile into one descriptor that
> serves a REST admin API, a Nuxt/Vuetify admin UI (standalone or hosted
> by the PHP application) and Model Context Protocol tools, all under the
> application's own authentication and per-resource policies.

Vector ships as `kinetis/vector` (the PHP package) and
`@kinetis/vector-ui` (the admin UI, a Nuxt layer). The pages are ordered
from first install to the reference.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/getting-started.html): Install the package, wire authentication, declare a first resource and open the admin.
- [Core concepts](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/core-concepts.html): The compiled descriptor, the API as the authority, and how the UI and MCP tools follow from it.
- [The demo application](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/demo.html): The Docker stack with a shop on MySQL and a support desk on PostgreSQL, both admin modes, FrankenPHP worker mode and the benchmark.

## Using the admin

- [Using the admin](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/using-the-admin.html): Signing in, navigation, badges, the dashboard, global search, notifications, jobs, settings and impersonation.
- [Lists](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/lists.html): Search, sort, filters and "any of" groups, grouping, summaries, columns, saved views, bulk operations, inline edits, export and import.
- [Records](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/records.html): The record page, forms, related records, history and revert, the trash and actions.

## Building the admin

- [Resources](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/resources.html): The resource class: attribute, derived or declared fields, definition methods, request-time hooks, badges and global search.
- [Fields](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/fields.html): The field catalog, common modifiers, filter operators, relations and money.
- [Forms](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/forms.html): Conditions, dependent choices, repeaters, inline editing and optimistic locking.
- [Actions](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/actions.html): Operations with dialogs, run on records, selections or everything a filter matches, directly or queued.
- [Dashboards and widgets](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/dashboards.html): Stat, trend, partition, progress and table widgets; dashboards; caching.
- [Files and images](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/files.html): Uploads checked by content, private storage and serving.
- [Settings](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/settings.html): Settings groups edited in the admin, and the built-in Branding, Languages and Background jobs groups.

## Access

- [Authentication](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/authentication.html): The vector middleware group, bearer and session modes, and the actor resolver for jobs.
- [Authorization](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/authorization.html): Resource policies, row scope, field visibility and per-record permissions.
- [Audit trail and impersonation](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/audit.html): The field-level history, revert, and acting as another user.

## Background work

- [Background jobs](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/jobs.html): Queued actions, large and Excel exports and imports: requirements, the queue they go to, delivery and stalled jobs.

## Deployment and customization

- [Deployment](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/deployment.html): Standalone and hosted modes, the Content Security Policy, and production builds.
- [Customizing the UI](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/customizing-the-ui.html): Application config, custom cells, inputs and widgets, runtime extensions, custom pages and theming.
- [Languages](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/languages.html): The shipped languages, the languages on offer, translating your labels and overriding the UI's messages.
- [Databases](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/databases.html): Entities on several connections, Vector's tables on their own, and dialect notes.

## Integrations

- [MCP tools](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/mcp.html): The admin's services as Model Context Protocol tools for AI agents.
- [Testing your admin](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/testing.html): Driving the REST API from the application's own test suite.

## Reference

- [REST API](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/rest-api.html): Every route, envelope, wire value, the list grammar and errors.
- [Configuration](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/configuration.html): Every environment key and UI setting.
- [Limits and guarantees](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/limits.html): Bounds, guarantees and known limits.

## Working on Vector

- [Working on Vector](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/contributing.html): The monorepo layout, the test suites, static analysis, mutation testing and continuous integration.
- [AI coding agents](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/coding-agents.html): Working on this repository with an AI coding agent through Orbitron: session setup, client configuration and diagnostics.
- [Releasing](https://kinetis.dev/vector/docs/releasing.html): Independent versions in packages.manifest.json, bumped in the pull request with scripts/bump.mjs and checked by versions.yml; release on merge to main to the mirror kinetis-dev/vector and npm; the mirror's history rule, one-time setup and recovery.
